source: SVC-9 Fig. 9-8 board 3 headphone amplifier, PDF p. 10 (SVC-204D PDF p. 66)
wiring_source: SVC-9 Fig. 9-17 interconnecting wiring diagram, PDF p. 19 (SVC-204D PDF p. 75)

connections.note: The board-3 schematic labels the branch output to stereo headphones and draws both signal contacts together.

scope: Output coupling only, with imposed ideal voltage at the Q11/R33 and Q10/R32 common node before C21
uncertainty: The amplifier's output resistance, DC bias and current limit, C21 ESR/leakage/tolerance, the jack contacts and the actual headphone drivers are unmeasured. External tip/ring impedances are scenario parameters.
